This is a temporal ordering constraint: moving block1 (i.e., picking up or moving) must be followed by moving block4 later. In classic STRIPS, we cannot enforce ordering directly, but we can encode via a predicate that tracks whether block1 has been moved, and require that block4 cannot be moved until after block1 has been moved. Or the constraint says: if you move block1, you must move block4 after. So we need to enforce that any plan that moves block1 must also later move block4 (i.e., block4 must be moved at some point after block1). This can be encoded by a predicate (moved ?b) that becomes true when block is moved (pickup or unstack). Then we add a precondition to actions that move block4 requiring (moved block1) i.e., block1 must have been moved before moving block4. However, the constraint is conditional: only if block1 is moved, block4 must be moved after. If block1 is never moved, block4 can be moved anytime. (define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  ;; basic predicates for blocksworld
  (:predicates 
    (on ?x ?y)          ; ?x is directly on ?y
    (on-table ?x)       ; ?x is on the table
    (clear ?x)          ; nothing on top of ?x
    (holding ?x)        ; the robot arm is holding ?x
    (arm-empty)         ; the robot arm is empty
    (height ?x ?h) )    ; ?x is at height ?h in its current stack (h1 = top of table)

  ;; -----------------------------------------------------------------
  ;; Actions – standard pick‑up / put‑down / unstack, plus specialised stack actions
  ;; that respect the maximum stack height of 5 (i.e., we only allow stacking onto
  ;; blocks whose height is h1‑h4).  Stacking onto a block of height h5 or higher would
  ;; create a stack of height >5, which is prohibited.
  ;; -----------------------------------------------------------------

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (height ?b h1))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (not (on-table ?b))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 (not (height ?b h1))))

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (height ?b h1)))

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (height ?b ?h))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (clear ?c)
                 (not (on ?b ?c))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 (not (height ?b ?h))))

  ;; Stack actions – each corresponds to the height of the destination block.
  ;; Only stacks onto heights h1‑h4 are allowed (resulting heights h2‑h5).

  (:action stack-1
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (height ?c h1))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c))
                 (height ?b h2)))

  (:action stack-2
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (height ?c h2))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c))
                 (height ?b h3)))

  (:action stack-3
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (height ?c h3))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c))
                 (height ?b h4)))

  (:action stack-4
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (height ?c h4))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c))
                 (height ?b h5)))
)

    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)))
  )
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (not (clear ?c)) (not (holding ?b)) (arm-empty) (stacked-by-action ?b))
  )
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (stacked-by-action ?b)))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
